description: Reads a website's sitemap.xml and returns each page's title, meta description and word count as JSON. Checks up to 25 pages per call (one level of sitemap index), with a 25-second time limit. Every page is fetched through a public-internet-only safe fetcher. Use it to audit a site's SEO basics or to get a quick content inventory before crawling. Paid only: $0.25 per call via x402 at https://tools.orchardshop.xyz/t/sitemap-to-index.
name: sitemap-to-index
